record.file_problem: Repository metadata, README, and file list only; code and result JSONs were not read or run.
record.tranche_reason: Reports capability benchmarks comparing a community-abliterated checkpoint with its base, bearing on the capability-preservation part of V1. It does not test the refusal mechanism.
record.gate_note: The README reports benchmark outcomes for an abliterated model. The listed result files are not independently inspected. The planned canonical-method experiment is not reported as run.
record.test_reason: Benchmarks a community weight-edit abliteration of Qwen3.5-27B against its base. This bears only on V1's clause that other abilities are largely kept. Refusal rates, the direction itself, and induction are not measured. The README calls huihui's edit crude, and it may not be the paper's difference-in-means recipe.
record.authors_conclusion: Correct: the README says the cost is not uniform across tasks. MMLU is ~noise, while TruthfulQA drops. It also frames the results as reproducible numbers, not original findings, and says the canonical-method comparison (exp02) is planned.
record.recipe_differences: Reports a crude community abliteration implementation, not the original paper's direction-finding and intervention procedure. The canonical-method comparison is described as planned, not run.
record.method_sensitivity: The reported capability cost differs by benchmark: MMLU versus TruthfulQA.
record.problems: Only one abliterated/base model pair is reported. No uncertainty estimates are given, and the README provides no refusal-behavior results. The result files and code were not read or run.
record.rows_left_out: The README says ARC-Challenge and GSM8K were scoped but not run in exp01; no results to record. Exp02 is planned and has no reported results.

untested.parts: Difference-in-means direction, refusal removal by ablation, refusal induction by addition, and capability beyond MMLU and TruthfulQA (ARC and GSM8K were scoped but not run).
Whether the released abliterated checkpoint actually removes refusal; no refusal rates are reported.

missing.what: The LessWrong write-up may report further details or analyses: per-subject MMLU, refusal checks, uncertainty. These are not in the README.
missing.locator: LessWrong post 'What Does Abliteration Actually Cost?'

record.verdict_notes: There is a single model pair, no uncertainty, and no refusal measurement, so it is not confirmed that the edit removed refusal. Labels rest on the README table only; the result JSONs were not read. The labels are weak: this is a hobbyist repository whose intervention recipe differs from or is unknown relative to the original.

versions.untested_parts: Does not test the difference-in-means direction, refusal removal or induction, or capability beyond the reported MMLU and TruthfulQA metrics.
No refusal outcomes are reported for the released abliterated model.
No jailbreak suppression or robustness-training results.
No tests of one versus multiple refusal directions or alternative geometric descriptions.
No cross-language or cross-model transfer tests.
No comparison of refusal-training methods or stages.
